AST-aware insertion of a new symbol into an existing file.
Infers placement from the symbol's qualified name (method
goes into parent class; top-level function goes end of file).

file rewrite.

One-shot batch creation of all architecture files. Generates the
whole project in shared context, slices per-file, gates each file

a batch summary to mission_control.

In-graph task router: pick flow_set (ops|code_core) + capability profile
via two menu turns, persist them onto the mission, and hand off to the
chosen controller. The full-local autonomy entry (flow_set=="auto");
explicit config skips it.

Surgical path-scoped edit of a YAML data file via data_ops. Translates
the prose change_spec into structured operations (set/add/remove/move at
RFC-6901 pointers), dry-runs them, and writes the result — preserving
comments and key order. Falls back to full rewrite on any miss.

deep_research.description:
Parallel stateless research sweep: decompose the brief into independent
angles, fan them out (search+condense per angle) on the batched engine,
reflect on the merged ledger between waves, synthesize with citations.

wave.description: Fan out all open angles: per-angle search + condense

merge_reflect.description: Ledger audit → sufficient, or the next wave's gaps

synthesize.description: One inference: ledger → grounded summary + citations

unavailable.description: Declined (web_research off / no brief) — empty summary

deep_search.description:
Bounded reflect-and-refine web-research loop: name the missing fact,
search it, condense the hits into the session, repeat, then synthesize a
grounded summary. The shared deep-search primitive.

Design or reconcile project architecture, then derive project goals.

full architecture design is needed (no architecture), reconciliation
is needed (drift detected), or goals can be derived directly.

seeds it with goal + test result + transcript + project + prior
attempts, then loops on a single compound menu (trace a symbol,
or conclude). Each trace injects cross-file evidence into the
session's KV cache. Model decides when it has enough signal to
conclude; otherwise the flow auto-concludes after 8 turns.

patch.description:
Surgical AST-aware editing of the diagnose-named symbol plus
related symbols, spanning files when related_symbols are
file-qualified. Generates single-symbol bodies; the splicer
places each at AST-computed line offsets; each file is written
once as its queue drains. Relies on diagnose naming the exact
target_symbol and file_ops routing guaranteeing AST presence.

patch_module.description:
Module-frame editor: the model edits a file's non-symbol frame
(imports, docstring, top-level, __main__) while function/class
bodies are preserved and spliced back deterministically. Fired for
import-class fixes the symbol patch can't express. Any splice
mismatch → full_rewrite_requested (file_ops falls back to rewrite).

prepare_context.description:

manifest and AST-based dependency map. Zero inference calls.

project_ops.description:
Initialize project tooling and structure. Creates config files,
directories, installs dependencies, and detects validation tooling.
project_ops.flow_persona:
[Role: project infrastructure — package installation, dependency management, config, directory structure;
 Approach: installs packages (pip install, cargo add, npm install), generates setup files (pyproject.toml, configs, init files), runs setup commands;
 Scope: dependencies and configuration only — does not create source code files]
Receives a flow_directive for project setup. Installs required packages,
produces configuration files, and runs setup commands. Source code creation
is handled by file_ops. When a missing package is diagnosed, this is the
correct flow — do not work around missing imports in source code.

quality_gate.description:
Project-wide quality validation. Four-phase gate:
1. Deterministic checks — file scan, cross-file consistency, lint
2. Behavioral validation — run_commands (fast-fail), then
   run_session (UX verification, completion mode only)
3. Summary — LLM reviews all results and emits findings
4. Verification — findings with repros are probed against the
   live program; the verdict is derived from surviving claims

run_session.description:
Interactive terminal session driven by an execution persona.
The model acts as a user — tries things, observes, adapts.
Multi-turn with memoryful inference session. Uses PTY via MCP
for true interactive program support.

The inference session is kept alive after the PTY closes so
the calling flow can run evaluation in the same KV cache context.
The caller is responsible for ending the inference session.

rules.condition: context.mission != None and context.mission.architecture != None and len(context.mission.architecture.data_shapes or []) >= 2

author_data_registry.description: Coin one canonical entity-id namespace across the data files

store_data_registry.description: Parse + clean the registry (drop dangling refs) into data_registry

author_contracts.description: Author per-module symbol contracts (typed stubs + DbC docstrings + doctests)

parse_contracts.description: Parse + validate contract stubs; build skeletons and symbol slices

review_contracts.description: Fresh-context cohesion review of the contract set

apply_review.description: Apply the reviewer verdict: approve, or send back for revision

fan_out_workers.description: Implement every contract symbol with concurrent workers

assemble_files.description: Splice worker bodies into skeletons; write complete files only

reconcile_integration.description: Single integrator reconciles cross-file coherence over the assembled package

slice_and_write.description: Slice reconciled FILE blocks, diff against the blueprint, overwrite declared files

lookup_env.description: Ensure validation tooling is configured for the project language

run_set_env.description: No validation config yet — infer tooling for the project

run_batch_checks.description: Per-file gates: env checks for code, parse-validity for data

run_doctests.description: Run contract doctests against the reconciled modules

run_type_check.description: Cross-module interface consistency over reconciled files

apply_results.description: Book per-goal reports, complete passing goals, note the batch

report_success.description: Return to mission_control_integrated — batch written and booked

report_failed.description: Return to mission_control_integrated — batch produced nothing usable

mission_control_contracted.description:
Deterministic pipeline. Computes the current phase from goal
statuses and dispatches the appropriate work without LLM routing.
Phases: plan → structural sweep → environment → functional sweep → quality gate.

load_state.description: Load mission state and event queue

apply_last_result.description: Attach returning flow's directive report to goal

check_phase.description: Determine which pipeline phase to enter based on goal statuses

dispatch_planning.description: No architecture or goals — dispatch design_and_plan

dispatch_replan.description: Pending directive — decompose against the existing codebase

structural_sweep_next.description: Find next incomplete structural goal in creation order

dispatch_batch_create.description: Batch-create all architecture files in one generation

dispatch_structural_create.description: Create next file in dependency order

dispatch_structural_fix.description: Repair a structural file that failed its gate

input_map.flow_directive: Install all required dependencies and verify the project environment is ready.

resolve_fix_target.description: Model selects which file to fix based on diagnosis

fallback_fix_target.description: Menu unanswerable — take the top-ranked fix target deterministically

apply_fix_target.description: Apply LLM-selected fix target to dispatch config

dispatch_functional_test.description: Test a functional capability via interact

dispatch_functional_fix.description: Fix a file identified by failed functional test

dispatch_quality_gate.description: Final quality gate for mission completion

quality_sweep_next.description: Diagnose -> file_ops -> complete the next quality goal

dispatch_test_gate.description: Run the repo's test suite; harvest fix goals or certify

regression_sweep_next.description: Run all completed goals' acceptance checks; reopen regressed goals

dispatch_quality_fix.description: Dispatch a diagnose_issue/file_ops fix for a quality finding

curate_control.description:
Curator pipeline controller. Bootstraps the fig-review and
curation goals from the databank, sweeps both worklists, and
completes when the deterministic curation gate passes and the
corpus dataset is built.

load_state.description: Load mission state and event queue

apply_last_result.description: Attach returning flow's directive report to goal

bootstrap_goals.description: Derive the fig_review + curate corpus goals from the databank

check_phase.description: Determine the curator phase from goal statuses

dispatch_fig_review.description: Run the fig-review sidecar over the batch

curate_sweep_next.description: Dispatch the next paper to curate (repacks first)

dispatch_curate.description: Review + pack one paper in a session lifecycle

reopen_goal.description: Gate failed — reopen the corpus goals for the sweeps

curate_gate.description:
Deterministic curation gate: every extracted paper terminal,
corpus.json built. The dataset + key registry are the next
stage's input contract; zero silent inclusions by construction.

check.description: Every extracted record terminal for both passes?

build_corpus.description: Merge accepted envelopes + registry into corpus.json

gate_fail.description: Papers pending or corpus inconsistent — controller reopens

curate_paper.description:
Review one extracted paper (accept/deny as a data reference)
and, if accepted, pack its raw data into the open-key dataset
behind deterministic gates. Ingest once, snapshot, branch.

ingest_review.description: Ingest the curator doc, review it, pin the snapshot

pack_data.description: Pack raw data behind the deterministic gates (one snapshot-fork retry)

book_result.description: Book the outcome; end session + purge snapshot (all paths)

return_success.description: Report the paper's outcome to curate_control

return_failed.description: Report a booking failure to curate_control

fig_review.description:
VLM figure readings (figtext) for a batch of extracted papers
via the fig_review sidecar; book results into the databank.

review_figs.description: Run the VLM sidecar and book figtext results

extract_control.description:
Extractor pipeline controller. Bootstraps the corpus extraction
goal from the databank, sweeps pending OA PDFs through the
Paddle-MLX toolchain in batches, and completes when the
deterministic extraction gate passes.

load_state.description: Load mission state and event queue

apply_last_result.description: Attach returning flow's directive report to goal

bootstrap_goals.description: Derive the corpus pdf_extract goal from the databank

check_phase.description: Determine the extractor phase from goal statuses

pdf_extract_sweep_next.description: Dispatch the next extraction batch (retries first)

dispatch_extract.description: Run the extraction toolchain over the batch

reopen_goal.description: Gate failed — reopen the corpus goal for the sweep

extract_gate.description:
Deterministic extraction gate: every OA PDF terminal. The
per-record extraction_quality distribution is the stage's
scorecard and the dataset stage's input contract.

gate_pass.description: Extraction complete — corpus ready for the dataset stage

gate_fail.description: Papers still pending — controller reopens the sweep

extract.description: Run the extraction toolchain and apply the quality policy

ops_control.description:
Ops pipeline controller. Derives one task goal from the objective,
then drives run_session work cycles (which derive the grounded
definition-of-done) and judges completion against the done-checks
until the task is complete.

load_state.description: Load mission state and event queue

apply_last_result.description: Attach returning flow's directive report to goal

bootstrap_goals.description: Derive the single task goal + TaskState from the objective

check_phase.description: Task incomplete → work cycle; complete → finish

dispatch_task.description: Run one work cycle (charter → run_session → check → judge)

ops_task.description:
One ops work cycle: accomplish-charter → run_session → completion
checks → judge → complete or loop-with-feedback.

gather_context.description: Scan the working directory so the charter plans against real files

exa_probe_gate.description: Gate the stuck-task web search (attempts >= 2, once)

exa_search.description: Web-search the stuck problem via the Exa MCP

store_search_findings.description: Store the exa hits on the mission for the charter (one-shot)

plan_provision.description: Plan setup/install commands the task's environment needs

run_provision.description: Run the planned setup/install commands (in the container)

plan_charter.description: Write an accomplish-charter for the terminal session

run_terminal.description: Accomplish the task in an interactive terminal session

gate_reground_criteria.description: Gate the grounded criteria derivation (until grounded)

reground_criteria.description: Derive the definition-of-done grounded in the explored workspace

store_reground_criteria.description: Store the grounded done-criteria (union-merge; retry while empty)

run_checks.description: Run the completion checks against the final state

gate_reground.description: Gate the grounded output-format derivation (fires once)

reground_output_format.description: Re-derive the output-format spec grounded in the scanned workspace

store_reground_format.description: Parse + store the grounded spec; mark grounded (one-shot)

artifact_oracle.description: Deterministic artifact rungs (sanity + format + profile), one read

sanity_plausibility.description: Judge whether the produced answer is plausible (type/magnitude)

record_sanity.description: Append a required fail on a confident implausible verdict

probe_gate.description: Gate the asym-probe to function+examples tasks

probe_generate.description: Generate a property-based differential test for the candidate

probe_run.description: Run the property test; append PASS/FAIL as a required check

judge_step.description: Judge whether the task is complete

reprobe_completion.description: Re-probe completion criteria + artifact when the judge claims done

verify_completion.description: Confirm genuine completion from the fresh re-probe

record_completion_verify.description: Append a required fail on a confident not-done verify verdict

decide.description: Complete the goal (done) or store feedback (loop)

return_loop.description: Not done — return to ops_control for another cycle

acquire_catalog.description:
Acquire and catalog a batch of candidate papers: OA resolution,
PDF download, reference fetch, and aspect tagging
(exact/close/adjacent) grounded in the abstracts.

load_mission.description: Load mission (research plan aspects for tagging)

load_batch.description: Load the dispatched paper records from the databank

resolve_oa.description: Assign access_status (known OA url -> Unpaywall -> closed)

download.description: Download oa_pdf papers; failures downgrade to oa_unresolved

fetch_refs.description: Store reference DOIs (corpus edges computed at gate time)

tag_papers.description: Tag the batch against the plan's aspects (one turn)

apply_tags.description: Validate tags, persist cataloged records, build the report

return_success.description: Return the catalog report to research_control

discover.description:
Scholarly discovery round: refine queries for one aspect, search
S2 + OpenAlex, merge candidates into the workspace databank
(DOI-keyed dedup), and return a directive report.

refine_queries.description: Refine scholarly queries for the aspect

extract_queries.description: Parse refined queries into a structured list

merge.description: Dedup candidates into the databank; build the report

return_success.description: Return the discovery report to research_control

plan_research.description:
Decompose the mission's research abstract into aspects with seed
queries and coverage targets (mission.research_plan), then derive
per-aspect discovery goals plus one corpus catalog goal.

design_plan.description: Decompose the abstract into research aspects

derive_goals.description: Per-aspect discovery goals + the corpus catalog goal

complete.description: Plan stored — return to the controller

research_control.description:
Scraper pipeline controller. Computes the current phase from goal
statuses (SCRAPER_PHASES) and dispatches discovery/catalog work
against the workspace databank; the research gate derives the
completion verdict from coverage and tag grounding.

load_state.description: Load mission state and event queue

apply_last_result.description: Attach returning flow's directive report to goal

check_phase.description: Determine the scraper phase from goal statuses

dispatch_planning.description: No research plan or goals — dispatch plan_research

discovery_sweep_next.description: Dispatch the next incomplete aspect's discovery round

dispatch_discover.description: Run a discovery round for one aspect

dispatch_catalog.description: Acquire and catalog a batch of candidate papers

harvest_findings.description: Reopen aspect goals / mark retags from gate findings

research_gate.description:
Research completion gate: aspect coverage (exact+close tags vs
targets), corpus cross-link finalization, and tag-grounding
probes. Verdict derived from probed facts.

load_mission.description: Load mission (research plan for coverage targets)

prepare_grounding.description: Sample tags; cheap overlap check; queue survivors

judge_grounding.description: Judge whether the abstract supports the queued tags

record_grounding.description: Record the judge verdict, advance the queue

apply_results.description: Derive the verdict from coverage + grounding facts

gate_fail.description: Coverage or grounding issues need attention
